$comment: Registry of local apps served behind the Caddy reverse proxy. Each app gets a friendly hostname (app.<name>) mapped in the Windows hosts file to 127.0.0.1, and Caddy on :80 routes that hostname to the app's high port. Add a new app by appending an entry here, then re-run deploy/generate-caddyfile.ps1, deploy/update-hosts.ps1 (elevated), and deploy/register-startup.ps1 (elevated). Ports are reserved in the 9000s band to avoid conflicts with common services and the Windows ephemeral range (49152+).
